label: Dependence shape control checked
description: Reuse the existing controls_of_wellFounded and the existing monotone transmission operator. Unit subsingletonity rules out injective infinite sequences but does not rule out a self-loop. Direct fixed-point inequalities distinguish source-free least and greatest interpretations. Nat successor supplies a strict infinite reverse-order chain. Finite inductive grounding on the cycle has a declared intrinsic base and implies no graph-wide well-foundedness.
